notes: Brine: crab-shelled Concord dock-union workers, on THE LARGE RIG: the frame is 49x49 with the pivot at (24,24) (the normal 2x2 body, 32 px, sits at the centre, its shadow and pathing stay there; the art overhangs it). Mounts and hands are the shared targets moved by (+8,+8), identical relative to the pivot, so every item fits (item top-left = mount - item.grip). A broad brick-red carapace with a row of orange spines along its front edge and salt-crust specks, three jointed crab legs a side in the legs layer (they step in alternation at 6 fps), two eyes on stalks, ONE BIG WORK CLAW on the right arm (a red pincer with a toothed bite that straddles the held item) and a small claw on the left. Head variants: stalks, goggles (union goggles, tinted frames), helmet (a dock hard hat, tinted). Outfit mask = the crossed cargo straps, the claw's wrist band, the goggle frames, the hard hat. Same rig as human: every layer faces UP at rotation 0 on one 49x49 frame, rotate about the pivot; outfit pixels are neutral grey in the base PNG and white in *_color.png (multiply by the outfit colour there); no baked shadow.

legs.notes: frames 0 and 3 are the contacts; the swing boot (frames 1-2 right, 4-5 left) is lifted

arms.notes: item placement: item top-left = mount - item.grip (both unrotated), then rotate the upper group about the pivot. Mounts are identical on every species (and the human), so any item fits any body. Pose = the item's class: pistol, rifle, tool, heavy, melee. RIG KIND large: this frame is 49x49 with the pivot at (24,24), so every mount here is the shared one moved by (+8,+8): mount - pivot is identical to the human rig.
